name: Fortifications on the Caribbean Side of Panama: Portobelo-San Lorenzo
description: Along Panama's Caribbean coast in Colón Province, the stone forts of Portobelo and San Lorenzo guarded the route by which Spain shipped treasure and trade goods across the isthmus. Built in the 17th and 18th centuries, these weathered ruins overlook the sea with their batteries and walls still visible. The site is currently on the List of World Heritage in Danger.
